pair.title: Add eWind ventilation system
pair.nosettings: Please fill in all the required fields.
pair.intro: Enter the IP address and port of your eWind Wifi-dongle and ensure you have set Modbus TCP to ON in the app.

freeway.title: Add Freeway WEB ventilation system
freeway.intro: Enter the IP address and port of your Freeway WEB adapter. First enable Modbus/TCP in the Freeway's own web interface: Configuration → Access control configuration, put your Homey's IP address in “IP address of Modbus/TCP client” and click Save Modbus/TCP. Until you do, the adapter refuses connections on port 502.
